Isaiah deploys it for the finest valleys and loftiest cedars (Isa 22:7; 37:24), while Ezekiel selects 'the choicest of the flock' for a grim siege-pot allegory (Ezek 24:4–5). Daniel closes the biblical usage with 'his choice troops' (Dan 11:15), soldiers handpicked for their quality."
